figures.finding: Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon sets its own income tax under its local tax code (France's CGI does not apply): for 2025 income, taxed in 2026, the scale per family share is 0% to €10,140, then rises 5 points per band to 50% from €54,600 and 55% above €68,300; pay is first reduced by 10% (at least €500) and then a further 20%, and a single person deducts €550.
figures.applies: Scale applied per part of the quotient familial (1 for a single person). Read from the tax service's own 2026 calculator (bands and the function that applies 5% per band).

figures.finding: A non-resident with income taxable in the archipelago is taxed at a 10% rate in the calculator, with a minimum-tax base of €5,500.
figures.applies: Whether the 10% is withheld at source, and whether it is final, was not found.

figures.finding: A self-employed (non-commercial, BNC) worker whose receipts are under €38,000 may use the micro-BNC regime, taxed on receipts less a flat 35%.
figures.applies: Applies to a freelance writer, director or performer billing as BNC.

sources.said: Pour les bénéfices non commerciaux dont le chiffre d'affaires est inférieur à 38 000 € : Régime du Micro-BNC : abattement forfaitaire de 35 %

figures.finding: There is no VAT in Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon: the local tax system has no indirect contributions such as VAT.

sources.said: Une des principales caractéristiques de la fiscalité locale est l’absence de contributions indirectes telles que la TVA.

figures.finding: The income year is the calendar year: income of 2025 is declared to the local tax office and taxed in 2026.
figures.applies: The 2026 filing and payment dates were not read (the calendar page lists none in text).

sources.said: une déclaration qui doit être déposée à la direction des services fiscaux lo - cale, dans laquelle il vous appartient d'indiquer le montant des revenus perçus en 2025 par votre foyer fiscal pour la période courant du jour de votre installation dans l’archipel au 31 décembre 2025.

figures.finding: In Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon, as at 1 January 2025, an employee pays 9.67% of pay to the local social security scheme (health 2.75%, old age 6.92%, up to the monthly ceiling of €3,925) plus Agirc-Arrco supplementary pension (3.15% to the ceiling, 8.64% above), and the employer 29.086% or 29.486%; a self-employed worker pays 33.94% to 34.34% (health 9%, old age 15.29%, accidents 1.50%, family 8%) plus supplementary pension of 7% and 8%.
figures.applies: Employees and self-employed workers in Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon; the CLEISS table is dated 1 January 2025 and no 2026 table was found (unemployment 4% from 1 May 2025).
